title: Last call for AI Game Dev meetup in Toronto on October 7! Comment or DM for Luma link
author: MunchyCerealGuy
selftext:
I'm hosting an AI Game Dev meetup tomorrow night (October 7) in Toronto, Canada

This will be a relaxed evening with food, drinks, and plenty of time to meet other AI game devs in the space. We'll start with optional 5-10 minute demos to get to know each other and what we're working on, then spend most of the night talking more in depth about the cool details of our projects. If you're vibe coding games or using agents in game development/design in a novel and interesting way, please consider coming!!

Please comment below so I can share the link to register or you can DM me directly

comments.author: TPM2209
comments.body: Hit me up with the link.

replies.author: MunchyCerealGuy
replies.body: For sure, could you pls enable dms?

comments.author: GlobalCurry
comments.body: Are there any of these meetups in other regions?

replies.author: MunchyCerealGuy
replies.body: I'm doing this one in Toronto because that's where I am but I'm hoping this post also inspires other ppl to host their own! Do you have a request for a location?
